steps.name: Harmonia's Necklace (1)
steps.objective: Talk to Ell in "White Col Canyon", then find [Harmonia] in "Old Belos".

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you thinking about so hard that you can't hear me calling?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Oh, you're here. What can I do for you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't think I properly thanked you for your help.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Please, I learned more from the experience myself.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I'm not sure whether to call this a problem... But there's something I need to tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know if I can help, but I'll listen.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Y-you have to help me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's gotten you so frightened? Is there a ghost beside you or something?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: A-aaah! P-please stop!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So it is ghosts.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I'm ashamed to let you see me like this. Sigh...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Ever since I met Lady Jenna, I've begun seeing things I couldn't see before. I thought she was the only exception...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I can see what appears to be the entrance to Lady Iris's Inner World, and the spirits inside.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I've seen spirits take physical form occasionally, but that's different. They chose to appear before humans.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: What about you, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm all right. Things just turned out that way...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I'm not. It's different from Ull's keen spiritual perception...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You've defeated fiends in battle, Ell. Why are you afraid of ghosts and souls?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Perhaps because my older brother used to frighten me with them when I was little.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you'd rather not see them. But what about Jenna...?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Isn't there some way to let me see only Lady Jenna and nothing else?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (She looks desperate. In that case...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go speak with a Spirit King.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Th-thank you! I'll serve you faithfully, so please help me!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That won't be necessary. I said I'd help, so I'll be back soon!

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I'll wait eagerly for your return!

steps.name: Harmonia's Necklace (2)
steps.objective: Defeat the [The Serpent's Shadow] in the "Star of the Void" and obtain the <Serpent Shadow's Horn> and <Serpent Shadow's Scale>. Then report to [Harmonia] in "Old Belos".

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Welcome, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Harmonia, I came to ask a favor.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Is it about Ell?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know Ell?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Yes. As I mentioned before, I know something of matters involving the people in Lumen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That makes things easier.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: The relic is responsible for Ell's fear. She is nearly invincible against things she can see, but she fears what she cannot.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The Flame of Truth... An ancient relic could certainly have that effect.)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Suddenly seeing things that were invisible before would make anyone uneasy. However...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: However?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Ell is a special case. It may be difficult to suddenly make those beings invisible to her again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, what should we do...?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I can make some medicine instead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medicine?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Taking it would give her some control. She could erase beings she doesn't wish to see... I can make it using the necklace's power, but...

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I'm worried I might disappoint her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are there side effects?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: No, none.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then wouldn't it be all right?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: When you bring Ell the medicine, please be sure to ask her. I may have made it, but whether to take it is entirely her choice. Some choices inevitably leave regrets.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Can you make it right away?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Not immediately. I need you to gather the ingredients. Once you bring them, I'll purify them with the necklace's power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What ingredients do you need?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Remnants of the false serpent you encountered. One scale and one horn will do.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: You can give me ones you already have. If you don't have any, you should find them easily where you obtained them before.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Would you leave the Inner World, then return with the ingredients? I can't quite explain it in words, but it's because of the necklace's power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, all right. I'll see you shortly.
(Once the adventurer leaves the Inner World, Geis slowly approaches Harmonia.)

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: The adventurer was here. The feeling is certainly different from before.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: You sensed it too. The adventurer is certainly...

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Harmonia.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Yes...

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: I don't understand your thoughts. Still, you are doing your best within your role, so I will say no more.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: I do commend you for allowing the human who needs the medicine to choose.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: As I said before, I hope the choice made by Lady Leda's necklace does not bring misfortune. If it does, we must help.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Geis...

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Whatever you say, that is the course we must take. You and I are spirits born from a god's hands. We must accept it.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Yes...

steps.name: Harmonia's Necklace (3)
steps.objective: Talk to [Harmonia] in "Old Belos", then find [Ell] in "White Col Canyon".

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Oh, you're back, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I brought what you asked for.
(Harmonia takes the horn and scale, gathering them in her hands with the necklace she holds.)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Please wait a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Take your time.
(After a moment, the horn and scale change shape, becoming a small white bead.)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: The will of creation has taken a new form.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Creation?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... Ouroboros?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I simply used the will within a part of Ouroboros.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...So you knew too, Harmonia.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: For us, perhaps not knowing would be more difficult.
(Harmonia hands you the small jewel formed in her palms.)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Please take this to Ell. And remember to ask her.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Thank you, Harmonia. And...

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Adventurer, I trust you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go see Ell, then. Thank you, Harmonia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Harmonia's words made me forget what I was about to say. What was it...?)
(As the adventurer disappears through the entrance to the Inner World, Harmonia's composure breaks, and she sinks to the ground.)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Is this what Lady Leda meant? What does this necklace want...?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I've been waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Ell that Harmonia, Spirit King of Harmony and Stability, helped you.)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: So such a being exists. You're remarkable, %s, to have earned the trust of someone like that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've met so many people on my journey to find Iris. People who understand me, and people I want to understand...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Those are what we call bonds.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Bonds...? I suppose so...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: My brother used to say that if you felt that connection, you had received the wonderful gift of a bond.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. A gift... Oh, that reminds me. I have a gift for you, Ell.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: The medicine you mentioned.
(Ell takes the medicine and gazes at it.)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: What was invisible can suddenly become visible, yet what I've seen won't simply disappear. I can control it, but I won't stop seeing everything entirely...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Harmonia said whether to take the medicine is entirely your choice. It seemed like something she wanted you to understand.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I've made my choice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What will you do?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: For now, I'll try to enjoy seeing what I couldn't see before. If I think of it as broadening my perspective, it might even help my swordsmanship...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha. That's just like you, Ell. I'm sure you'll overcome this and advance even further on the path of the sword.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: You flatter me.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I'll keep this medicine for a time when I truly can't endure it... I only hope that time never comes.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I feel much lighter. Perhaps it wasn't medicine I needed, but a change in my outlook. I'll continue training here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Good luck. I'll be going.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Thank you. I'll see you again.
(After the adventurer leaves White Col Canyon, Ell begins swinging her sword in practice.)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Wait. Who's there? How long have you been there?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: (Where are you? Why can't I see you...?)
(As Ell stands on guard, a tremendous blow strikes her abdomen. She crumples to the ground.)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Ugh... Ah...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: This power... There's no mistaking it...

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: The one who killed my brother Elysion...
(Ell collapses unconscious, and the medicine falls from her clothes. The person who attacked her picks it up.)
